ai.title: Nutrient Data Extraction API: JSON Matching Your Schema With Per-Field Citations and Confidence
ai.brief: An LLM presents you a wrong value extracted from a document as fact. That error is costly, especially when basing decisions on it. The Nutrient Data Extraction API targets that problem. It parses PDFs, scans, images and Office files into spatial JSON or Markdown. Extract maps fields from a document onto your JSON schema, and split, classify and form endpoints provide useful primitives for your document pipelines. Each extracted value is anchored to a page via a bounding box, a match label and a confidence score. Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) runs the same engine behind an MCP server , agent skill, Mac app and SDK . TL;DR Size: A hosted API with 4 parse modes plus auto routing. Runs on: Nutrient cloud, your own servers via SDK, or an Apple silicon Mac. Where to try it: Studio , a browser workspace to configure and test parsing, extraction,classification, splitting, and form filling.

sec.title: nginx2root:AI Discovers Five Critical nginx Flaws and a Path to Root
sec.brief: Norwegian Gas Giant Equinor Says It's Under Cyberattack. S. S. Banks Struggle With Outages Amid Wider Technology Disruptions Xint Research has disclosed nginx2root , five distinct nginx vulnerabilities plus one Linux kernel bug, each with a proven exploit. The worst of the five, now tracked as CVE-2026-123007, lets an unauthenticated attacker run code remotely, and chaining it with the kernel bug reaches root on the host. “This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. ( CVE-2026-123007 )” reads the advisory .
